name: Jarvis
tagline: Reach into the screen to grab, scale and rotate 3D models with your hands, and ask a voice assistant about them.
problem: Spatial interaction usually needs a headset or special controllers.
solution: A webcam tracks hands to pinch, spread and rotate meshes in a custom 3D pipeline, while a live voice model answers questions about the object on screen.
demo_moment: Team-described: pinch a model, spin it, and ask the assistant what it is.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best use of CV” among 85 submissions.
Recreates a famous film scene with a plain webcam.

lessons: Name the movie moment you are recreating; the judges fill in the rest.
